popupExpandToggleTip: Enlarge the inner scrollable panels and iframes up to their full content, not capturing them as they appear. Frames from another site will ask for one additional permission only once.
optionsLead: Changes are saved automatically and synchronised to your browser profile.
optionsExpandPermGranted: Permission given — frames from other sites are expanded as well.
optionsExpandPermMissing: Without the "read all websites" permission, cross-site frames are captured only as they appear. Panels and iframes from the same site always function.
optionsRedactPIIDesc: Scans the text exposed by the page in order to find e-mails, telephone numbers, credit card numbers, identity card numbers and API keys, then applies a solid block over what matches inside the saved image. Text drawn as pixels cannot be read by it — a canvas, an image, a PDF, a video frame. Detection runs on your device; nothing at all is ever sent anywhere. For whole-page captures (document scrolling); that block is permanent, so check the result yourself.
scrollclipFormatHint: GIF can be played anywhere. WebM is smaller & smoother (recorded live inside your browser).
batchPermissionHint: Opening these pages requires a permission only once, on the first occasion.
batchPermissionDeclined: The permission to open those pages has been refused.
